title: toast at most one action
rule: At most one action — a static white, secondary, outline button; concise; only when the action is directly related to the toast text.
pass_when: Zero or one related concise action, styled as that secondary outline control.
fail_when: Two or more toast actions, or an unrelated action on the toast.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Polar modal max two bottom actions as this toast row.
